title: decompress helpers assume data.len() >= 2 without explicit check
description:
Lines 654, 727, 783, 840, 894: Internal decompress functions slice `data[1..]` without checking data.len() >= 2. The public decompress() checks for empty data, so this is safe today.

Risk: If these functions are ever made public or called from new paths, they could panic on 1-byte input.

Fix: Add explicit length check at start of each function, or document the precondition in a SAFETY comment.
